entries.en: Enter your email and password to sign in to your workspace.
entries.zh-CN: 在下方输入邮箱与密码以登录你的工作空间。

entries.zh-CN: 本地首次运行请设置 ZEUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD 与

entries.en: Data is a build-time snapshot of the real API; changes are disabled. Use the Docker deployment for the full console.
entries.zh-CN: 数据为构建时的真实 API 快照，修改类操作已禁用。完整功能见 Docker 部署版本。

entries.en: Only changes what you see. It does not change the workspace default.
entries.zh-CN: 只影响你自己的界面，不会改动工作区默认语言。

entries.en: The starting language for members who have not chosen one. Saving this affects everyone.
entries.zh-CN: 未做选择的成员会以这个语言开始。保存会影响所有成员。

entries.en: Members, teams and audit activity for this workspace, returned by the server after the session is verified.
entries.zh-CN: 工作空间的成员、团队与审计摘要，数据由服务端会话校验后返回。
当前工作空间内的全部成员
状态为 active 的成员

entries.en: Sign-ins and writes recorded by the server
entries.zh-CN: 服务端记录的登录与写操作

entries.en: Sorted by member count, from the member directory.
entries.zh-CN: 按成员数排序，数据来自成员目录。

entries.en: First few members from the directory, sorted by name.
entries.zh-CN: 成员目录中按姓名排序的前几位成员。

entries.en: Team and status for every member; full filtering lives in Users.
entries.zh-CN: 全部成员的团队与状态；完整筛选在用户管理页。

entries.en: Manage members and their roles here.
entries.zh-CN: 在这里管理成员以及他们的角色。

entries.en: Could not load the member directory
Deletes {name} ({email}). This writes to the audit log and cannot be undone.
entries.zh-CN: 将删除 {name}（{email}）。该操作会写入审计日志，且无法撤销。

entries.en: New members are created with status invited; the server generates a placeholder password hash.
entries.zh-CN: 新成员以 invited 状态创建，密码由服务端生成占位哈希。

entries.en: Data comes from the route loader and shares the list query cache.
entries.zh-CN: 数据来自 route loader，与列表共享同一份查询缓存。

entries.en: Saves after updating. The detail cache updates optimistically, rolls back on failure, and the list query is invalidated afterwards.
entries.zh-CN: 更新资料后保存。详情缓存先乐观更新，失败时回滚，列表查询随后失效。

entries.en: Member and team totals for this workspace, returned by the server after the role check.
entries.zh-CN: 汇总当前工作空间的成员与团队规模。数据由服务端在通过角色校验后返回。

entries.en: Sign-ins, authorization failures and writes are recorded by the server in SQLite, not in browser memory.
entries.zh-CN: 登录、越权尝试与写操作由服务端记录在 SQLite 中，并非浏览器内存。

entries.en: Could not load the audit log
Records appear here once a sign-in, write or authorization failure happens.
entries.zh-CN: 一旦发生登录、写操作或越权尝试，记录会出现在这里。

entries.en: The browser role only shapes the interface. Every read and write is re-checked by the server session.
entries.zh-CN: 浏览器的角色只用于界面呈现。每次读写都由服务端 session 重新校验。

entries.en: Manage members, roles, settings and audit records.
entries.zh-CN: 管理成员、角色、设置与审计记录。

entries.en: User CRUD, role changes, audit reads, uploads, settings writes
entries.zh-CN: 用户 CRUD、角色变更、审计读取、上传、设置写入

entries.en: Read-only access to users, reports and settings.
entries.zh-CN: 只读访问用户、报表与设置。

entries.en: User reads, report reads, settings reads
entries.zh-CN: 用户读取、报表读取、设置读取

entries.en: Manage the workspace name, language and theme; saving writes to the server SQLite.
entries.zh-CN: 管理工作空间的名称、语言与主题；保存后写入服务端 SQLite。

entries.en: Shown in the sidebar and on the sign-in page, up to 80 characters.
entries.zh-CN: 显示在侧栏与登录页的名称，最长 80 个字符。

entries.en: Saved to the server, so it survives a refresh or restart.
entries.zh-CN: 保存后写入服务端，刷新或重启后仍然保留。

entries.en: These settings apply to every member.
entries.zh-CN: 这些设置对所有成员生效。

entries.en: Text, Markdown, JSON and PNG only, up to 64 KiB. The server rejects path separators and hidden filenames.
entries.zh-CN: 仅接受文本、Markdown、JSON 与 PNG，上限 64 KiB。服务端拒绝路径分隔符与隐藏文件名。

entries.en: The server returns the file digest and SHA-256 after upload.
entries.zh-CN: 上传后服务端会返回文件摘要与 SHA-256。

entries.zh-CN: 加载出现异常，请返回用户列表重试。
